topic: Can MVDR beamforming sufficiently compensate for pattern degradation in array-fed reflectors during element failures?
consensus_response: MVDR beamforming can mitigate pattern degradation, but its effectiveness depends on defocusing level and feed array configuration. Defocused reflectors are more robust against element failures, while correlated failures exacerbate gain loss. Optimizing reflector surface and feed array together improves robustness.
reference_context: Defocused reflectors reduce gain loss due to reduced interference between feed elements, with average unit cell loss metrics provided.
